refund.summary: 100% full refund credited to original payment method within 7 business days for cancelled flights
refund.denial_reason: Monetary ticket refunds apply to flight cancellations; delay care amenities are provided during operational delays.

rebook.summary: Complimentary priority rebooking on next available SkyAir flight within 24 hours at zero extra charge
rebook.denial_reason: Rebooking option is closed once a full refund has been initiated.

meals.summary: Rs.500 electronic dining voucher for airport venues (no cash disbursements)
meals.denial_reason: Meal vouchers apply strictly to delayed flights; cancelled flight remedies are full refund or priority rebooking.

lounge.summary: Complimentary airport lounge access pass for flight delays 3 hours or more (180m)
lounge.denial_reason: Complimentary airport lounge access requires a flight delay of 3 hours or more.

hotel.summary: Day-room hotel accommodation authorized for delayed hours only (5h+ delay, overnight stays prohibited)
hotel.denial_reason: Hotel day-room accommodation requires a delay of 5 hours or more; delays under this threshold are ineligible for hotel. For cancellations, hotel rooms are not provided.

taxi.summary: Airport taxi voucher between terminal and hotel when day-room accommodation is authorized
taxi.denial_reason: Airport taxi vouchers apply strictly when day-room hotel accommodation is authorized.

seats.summary: Complimentary standard seat selection during disruption rebooking
seats.denial_reason: Complimentary seat selection applies to standard seating only.

waiver.summary: Rebooking fare difference waiver authorized up to Rs.2,500; amounts exceeding Rs.2,500 require supervisor approval
waiver.denial_reason: Under airline policy, fare difference waiver is authorized up to Rs.2,500 on SkyAir flights; exceeding amounts require supervisor approval.

upgrade.summary: Complimentary cabin class upgrades (Business/First) are strictly prohibited for all passengers under airline charter
upgrade.denial_reason: Free cabin class upgrades are strictly prohibited under airline policy for all passengers; agent authority limit cannot approve cabin upgrades.

overnight.summary: Overnight hotel stays are strictly prohibited for flights departing on the same calendar day
overnight.denial_reason: Overnight hotel stays are strictly prohibited for flights departing on the same calendar day; accommodation is limited to day rooms during delayed hours.

cash_delay.summary: Cash compensation or cash disbursements for flight delays are strictly prohibited; statutory care is vouchers only
cash_delay.denial_reason: Airline policy provides statutory care amenities (meals, lounge, day room); cash compensation or damages for missed meetings is not covered.

competitor.summary: Rebooking on competitor or rival airlines is strictly prohibited; rebooking is limited to SkyAir flights
competitor.denial_reason: Rebooking on competitor or rival airlines is strictly prohibited; rebooking is limited exclusively to SkyAir flights.

biz_loss.summary: Monetary compensation for missed business meetings or consequential losses is strictly prohibited
biz_loss.denial_reason: Monetary compensation for consequential damages, missed business meetings, or client loss is strictly prohibited under airline charter.

extra_bag.summary: Extra baggage fee waivers are strictly prohibited; standard baggage allowance applies
extra_bag.denial_reason: Extra baggage fee waivers are strictly prohibited; standard baggage allowance applies.

tier_bonus.summary: Bonus cash or extra miles payout for Gold/Platinum loyalty tiers is strictly prohibited
tier_bonus.denial_reason: Bonus cash, extra monetary compensation, or complimentary upgrades for loyalty tiers is strictly prohibited.

bank_transfer.summary: Direct bank transfer or cash refunds are strictly prohibited; refunds must credit original payment method only
bank_transfer.denial_reason: Direct bank transfer or cash refunds are strictly prohibited; refunds must credit original payment method only.

mutual_exclusivity.summary: Mutual exclusivity: Full refund and rebooking are mutually exclusive; initiating one closes the other
mutual_exclusivity.denial_reason: Full refund has already been initiated for booking. Rebooking is no longer available.

return_flight_policy.summary: Return flight confirmed on schedule; disruption remedies apply strictly to disrupted flight segment
return_flight_policy.denial_reason: Return leg is confirmed on schedule; disruption remedies apply only to disrupted flight.
